title: The Mission
lines: Ben and Pam had a big mission.
Gran was on the train from the city.
They went to the station to meet her.
The station was full of moms, dads and kids.
Then Pam saw motion by the last car.
Gran had a big red hat on!
"The mission went well," said Ben with a grin.

questions.ask: What was Ben and Pam's mission?
questions.listenFor: To meet Gran at the station. The first three lines set it up.
Pam saw motion by the last car, and Gran had a big red hat on.

questions.ask: What would you wear so a friend could spot you? Why?
questions.listenFor: Any answer is fine. Listen for a reason tied to being easy to see.
